title: Uncertainty-aware operator learning
goal: Test whether a constrained dynamical operator learned from uncertainty-aware trajectories improves held-out state and migration prediction without learning proposal or gate artifacts.

steps.name: development_fit_and_stability_checks
steps.output: development-only fits, cross-validation, calibration and stability artifact

steps.name: one_time_held_out_evaluation_and_decision
steps.output: GO, REVISE or HOLD decision with complete held-out artifact

data_boundary.new_data_rule: Any additional dataset must pass a data-only provenance/schema audit and be locked before operator fitting.

candidate_scope.complexity_rule: Do not promote an operator family unless diagnostics justify dynamics beyond the frozen baselines.

acceptance_gates.provenance_and_split_integrity: all source hashes, sequence roles and fit/evaluation boundaries reproduce
acceptance_gates.leakage: no held-out coordinates, labels, corruption truth or evaluation summaries enter fitting or model selection
acceptance_gates.held_out_predictive_improvement: operator must improve the pre-registered held-out primary score over both required baselines; a null result is REVISE, not a success
acceptance_gates.noninferiority: migration/state summary absolute error must not worsen by more than 0.10 px/frame versus the frozen best baseline
acceptance_gates.interval_calibration: nominal 90% predictive intervals must cover 80% to 98% of defined held-out cases
acceptance_gates.stability: no NaN/Inf, unbounded rollout, unstable spectral radius, or compatibility violation over the registered forecast horizon
acceptance_gates.reproducibility: artifact, environment, seeds and tests reproduce exactly on CI

decision_policy.GO: all gates pass and the operator adds held-out value beyond baselines
decision_policy.REVISE: implementation or calibration needs a bounded revision that does not use held-out results for tuning
decision_policy.HOLD: the diagnostics do not justify operator complexity or no independent held-out evaluation is available
decision_policy.biological_claim: never supported by this technical operator benchmark alone

current_decision: Stage D Step 2 is complete; operator performance remains HOLD until development fitting, stability checks and held-out evaluation pass.
